# External-Evidence Intake Rules

This folder is reserved for external evidence used only in the broader scouting and RR-context workstreams. It must not silently change frozen Lens A v1 rankings.

Every factual external-data file must include, at minimum:

- source: direct URL, official document title, or supplied-file identifier.
- retrieved_on: ISO date on which the fact was obtained.
- source_type: official, governing-body, tournament, verified scorecard, established journalism, video, or user-supplied.
- evidence_confidence: high, medium or low, with a short reason.
- claim_limitations: what the source does not establish.

Do not enter rumours, uncited social posts, inferred availability, private medical information, or unverified price claims. One source can support several claims, but each claim must be traceable through docs/evidence/claim_register.csv.

Suggested intake order: official squad/retention/auction source; official player profile; official tournament statistics; verified scorecard; then video or scouting observation with match reference.
